---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a new feature or enhancement
title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ""
---

## Problem Statement

A clear description of the problem or limitation you're facing. What are you trying to accomplish?

## Proposed Solution

Describe the solution you'd like to see implemented.

## Upstream reference (optional)

If this maps to an existing feature in the upstream [PyData Sphinx Theme](https://pydata-sphinx-theme.readthedocs.io/en/stable/), link to its docs and note which version introduced it. This repo's `.pydata-sphinx-source-version` file records the last upstream version scanned for porting — mention if your request is about something added after that version, since it likely hasn't been evaluated yet.

If there's no upstream equivalent (i.e. this would be a Hugo-only feature with no Sphinx counterpart), say so — those are welcome too, see `docs/content/hugo-only/`.

## Alternatives Considered (optional)

Have you considered any alternative solutions or workarounds (e.g. a site-level template override instead of a theme change)?

## Additional Context (optional)

Any other context, mockups, or examples that help illustrate the feature request.
